subject: Evidence ingest playbook & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@clearriverpay.com>; Tom Nguyen <tom@clearriverpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence ingest playbook & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Hi Marta / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candor and the level of detail from your security team. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay coordinated.

Key pain points you called out:
- Audit log retention and access: need immutable audit logs with customer-facing retention settings (30/90/365 days) and proof of retention policy in writing.
- SOC 2 scope & timing: you need a breakdown of controls in scope, plus the latest SOC 2 report or bridge letter and an expected completion window for any gaps we call out.
- Pen test evidence: summary of recent pen test findings, remediation notes, and any 3rd-party reports you can accept for review.
- Data residency & encryption keys: clarity on how customer data is segmented and whether we can integrate with customer KMS for keying.
- DPA amendments and parity: your procurement team asked for specific retention language and audit rights in the DPA.

What I committed to from Redwood on the call:
1) Send a lightweight "evidence ingest playbook" (attached spreadsheet) that maps the ask to the artifact we can provide, the owner, and an estimated time-to-deliver.
2) Share our current SOC 2 summary and the standard set of artifacts we typically provide to customers (bridge letter / SOC 2 readiness notes).
3) Provide a checklist for pen test artifacts and suggested redaction guidance for any sensitive items.
4) Propose a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones: artifact handoff, review window, DPA redline turnarounds, and an acceptance demo / security walk-through.

Proposed immediate next steps (please confirm):
- You: Share preferred delivery location (secure SFTP, private Drive folder, or upload to the HubSpot file area) and any access constraints (IP allowlist / VPN).
- Us (Ben + Karthik): Deliver the populated evidence matrix and SOC 2 summary by EOD Friday (09/30).
- You (security): Confirm whether internal pen test report redaction is acceptable; if not, we can arrange a redact-and-share workflow.
- Joint: Schedule a 30-minute follow-up next week for artifact review (I propose Thu 10/7 09:00 PT).

Attachments: redwood-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx (matrix mapping ask -> artifact -> owner -> ETA), redwood-soc2-outline.pdf

If any of this is off, call it out — otherwise we’ll proceed with the matrix and the SOC 2 summary.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0168

--
Attachment stub: redwood-evidence-matrix-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 34KB)
--

From: Marta Lopez <marta@clearriverpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@clearriverpay.com>, ClearRiver Payments Security <security@clearriverpay.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ingest playbook & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Thanks Ben — that summary is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Delivery location: prefer a private Google Drive folder shared with security@clearriverpay.com and SSO access; we cannot accept public S3 links.
2) Retention options: 90 or 365 days are our primary needs; 30 days is not sufficient for our regulator.
3) Pen test: we can share a redacted copy of our latest internal pen test; our external vendor report can be shared under an NDA if needed. Redaction is acceptable as long as CVE identifiers and remediation notes are present.

I’m attaching the VPN whitelist/egress requirements our infra team needs for any interactive triage session. Also, procurement will follow up on DPA redlines — they asked whether Redwood supports contract language that allows limited audit rights with 30-day notice.

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood stores customer input logs for more than 24 hours by default? We want clarity on token retention and whether there’s an option to disable logging for specific VPC deployments.
- If you have a sample playbook for redaction of pen test reports that customers commonly use, please attach.

Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of InfoSec | ClearRiver Payments
marta@clearriverpay.com

--
Attachment stub: clearriver-vpn-whitelist-request.pdf (pdf, 12KB)
--

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@clearriverpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence ingest playbook & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)

Marta — thanks for the clarifications. Replying with commitments and owners so nothing falls through the cracks.

Quoted for context:
> From: Marta Lopez <marta@clearriverpay.com>
> Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 16:22:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Evidence ingest playbook & next steps (SOC 2 / pen test / retention)
> 
> 1) Delivery location: prefer a private Google Drive folder shared with security@clearriverpay.com and SSO access; we cannot accept public S3 links.
> 2) Retention options: 90 or 365 days are our primary needs; 30 days is not sufficient for our regulator.
> 3) Pen test: we can share a redacted copy of our latest internal pen test; our external vendor report can be shared under an NDA if needed.

Our commitments / answers:
- Delivery location: we will upload artifacts to a private Drive folder and enable SSO-based access; drive link will be shared to security@clearriverpay.com (owner: Karthik). ETA: 09/30 EOD.
- Retention: Redwood hosted defaults to 24-hour token log retention for hosted plans, but for Dedicated/Private customers we support 90/365 day retention and can offer configurable retention settings. For the MAP we’ll include a decision point and explicit configuration steps. (Owner: Lauren)
- Pen test redaction: attaching our recommended redaction checklist and a sample redacted report. We can accept an NDA for full external vendor reports; procurement can coordinate. (Owner: Ben)

Action plan (owners + dates):
- Ben: Upload populated evidence matrix + sample redaction checklist to Drive and share link (ETA: 2027-09-30 17:00 PT).
- Karthik: Set up Drive folder with SSO access and IP restrictions per your whitelist doc (ETA: 2027-09-30 18:00 PT).
- Lauren: Draft retention configuration note for Dedicated/Private options and sample config snippets (ETA: 2027-10-04).
- Joint: 30-minute artifact review call — proposed Thu 2027-10-07 09:00 PT (please confirm).

If that all works I’ll proceed to upload.

Ben

--
